binding.createAction: sc_rogue.cpp:9480 if ( name == "kingsbane" ) return new kingsbane_t( name, this, options_str )

checks.finding: Exactly ONE occurrence of 'cooldowns.kingsbane' — the assignment in rogue_t's constructor — and ZERO occurrences of 'cooldowns.kingsbane->'. The member declaration inside the cooldowns_t struct is unqualified and so does not match. Every mutation — adjust(), reset(), duration assignment, charge change — would have to go through the arrow form, and none exists. Re-checked mechanically on every run.

_charge_cooldown is 0, so action_t::init takes the ordinary else-branch (action.cpp:721-724) and cooldown->duration is _cooldown = 60000ms. _charges is 0: there is no charge system and no recharge behaviour to model.

checks.search: grep for the rogue module's bulk cooldown-adjustment sites
checks.finding: Restless Blades (sc_rogue.cpp:8246-8254) adjusts nine Outlaw cooldowns and includes none of the abilities in this dataset. Deadly Pursuit (sc_rogue.cpp:10826-10832) calls adjust_recharge_multiplier over deadly_pursuit_cooldowns and is gated on talent.outlaw.deadly_pursuit. checks.finding: kingsbane_t declares neither. The base rogue_action_t::update_ready (line 2287) zeroes the cooldown only when secondary_trigger_type != NONE, which is false for a player-cast action.

binding.createAction: sc_rogue.cpp:9500 if ( name == "vanish" ) return new vanish_t( name, this, options_str )

checks.finding: Exactly ONE occurrence of 'cooldowns.vanish' — the assignment in rogue_t's constructor — and ZERO occurrences of 'cooldowns.vanish->'. The member declaration inside the cooldowns_t struct is unqualified and so does not match. Every mutation — adjust(), reset(), duration assignment, charge change — would have to go through the arrow form, and none exists. Re-checked mechanically on every run.

_charge_cooldown is 120000ms and _charges is 1, so action_t::init takes the charge branch (action.cpp:710-720) and sets cooldown->duration to the CHARGE cooldown while demoting _cooldown (1000ms) to the internal cooldown. cooldown_t is constructed with charges(1) and current_charge(1) (cooldown_impl.cpp:101,110), so setting charges to 1 changes nothing: the object behaves exactly as an ordinary cooldown of 120000ms. The EFFECTIVE recharge is the charge cooldown, never the nominal one.

checks.finding: vanish_t declares execute and ready only. `ready()` adds a guard — false while buffs.vanish is up — which makes the action LESS available and never more, so it cannot invalidate a lower bound on the recharge. It touches no cooldown field.
